cuhkAdmission.introduction: Nursing: Holistic Education For Holistic Care Nurses are dedicated to providing quality patient care and promoting public health. Nurses nowadays not only have to undergo technologically advanced and sophisticated training but also respond to the rapidly changing health care environment. The Nethersole School of Nursing at CUHK has been admitting enthusiastic students who are committed to serving in the health care field since its inception in 1991. CUHK’s nursing programme is known for its professional education and academic rigour. To prepare students for a successful nursing career, the programme provides a comprehensive range of courses, including biological and behavioural sciences, health promotion and maintenance, nursing research and information technology.

admission.title: Admission Requirements & Statistics (2025 Entry)
content: Programme: JS4513 Nursing (5-year full-time)
First Year Intake: 217
Annual Tuition Fee: HK$47,000 (local students)
Interview: Required (selected applicants)
2025 JUPAS Application & Offer Statistics:
Band A applications: 736
Band A offers: 228
Total applications: 3,737
Band A offer rate: ~31.0%
Band A applications per offer: ~3.2
2025 JUPAS Admission Scores (Best 5):
Median: 28.6
Lower quartile (LQ): 28.3
Upper quartile (UQ): 33.5
Median Admit Subject Profile (M row):
Chinese: 5*
English: 4
Mathematics: 5
CSD: A
Elective 1: 5
Elective 2: 5
Elective 3: 4
Minimum Entrance Requirements:
Chinese Language: Level 3
English Language: Level 3
Mathematics Compulsory Part: Level 2
Citizenship and Social Development: Attained
Two elective subjects at Level 3 (including at least one from Biology, Chemistry, Physics preferred; best of these weighted x1.2)
Applied Learning courses with 'Attained with Distinction I/II' accepted as extra elective
Note: Physics is given heavier weighting (x1.2) among preferred subjects.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Overview
content: The CUHK Nursing programme (Nethersole School of Nursing) offers a comprehensive 5-year curriculum that integrates biological and behavioural sciences, health promotion, nursing research, and information technology.
Key areas of study:
- Biological sciences (anatomy, physiology, pharmacology)
- Behavioural sciences (psychology, sociology)
- Health promotion and maintenance
- Nursing research and evidence-based practice
- Clinical placements in major Hong Kong hospitals
The programme emphasises holistic education for holistic care, preparing students to respond to a rapidly changing healthcare environment.
Students gain hands-on experience through state-of-the-art simulation labs and clinical placements across various specialties.
Graduates are eligible for registration with the Nursing Council of Hong Kong.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: According to the 2023/24 graduate survey, over 90% of CUHK Nursing graduates secure nursing positions in public hospitals or private healthcare settings.
Graduates work in a variety of specialties, including:
- Medical and surgical nursing
- Paediatrics
- Obstetrics and gynaecology
- Critical care
- Community health
- Mental health
The programme's strong reputation ensures high employability, with many graduates advancing to leadership roles in healthcare.
Career support includes clinical placement coordination and professional development workshops.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities
content: CUHK's main campus is located in Shatin, offering a scenic and spacious environment with over 9,000 hostel places.
Students benefit from the unique college system, which provides a close-knit community and extracurricular opportunities.
The Nethersole School of Nursing features modern simulation laboratories and clinical skills training centres.
CUHK is ranked #5 in the world and #1 in Asia and Hong Kong for nursing (QS World University Rankings by Subject 2025).
On-campus accommodation costs approximately HK$17,000 per year, with living expenses around HK$45,000.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Selection
content: JS4513 is a highly competitive programme with a Band A offer rate of approximately 31.0% in 2025.
Band A applications per offer: ~3.2
Admission scores (Best 5) are high: Median 28.6, LQ 28.3, UQ 33.5.
Selection is based on academic merit (DSE results) and interview performance.
Preferred subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) are given additional weighting (Physics x1.2).
Applicants should aim for at least Level 5* in Chinese and Level 5 in Mathematics to be competitive.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: CUHK's Nethersole School of Nursing has produced many leaders in healthcare, though specific named alumni are not publicly listed in the fact pack.
Faculty excellence:
- The school is consistently ranked among the top nursing schools globally (QS #5 in the world, #1 in Asia and Hong Kong).
- State-of-the-art simulation labs and clinical placements in major Hong Kong hospitals.
- Graduates have high employment rates and are eligible for registration with the Nursing Council of Hong Kong.
The programme's strong industry connections ensure graduates are well-prepared for the workforce.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships for local JUPAS students based on academic merit.
Scholarships may cover tuition fees and living expenses for outstanding students.
Financial aid schemes are available, including the Tertiary Student Finance Scheme (TSFS) and Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS).
For details, visit: https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/
The annual tuition fee for local students is HK$47,000 (2026-2027).

tips.title: Ace Sir's Nursing Admission Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: Aim for Median 28.6 (Best 5)**
- With median 28.6 and LQ 28.3, you need strong grades across all subjects.
- Chinese 5*, English 4, Maths 5, plus two electives at 5 or above.
- Physics is weighted x1.2, so a high score in Physics can boost your total.
**2. Prioritise Band A Placement**
- Band A applications have a ~31% offer rate; Band B-E receive zero offers.
- Place JS4513 as your first choice (Band A) to maximise chances.
**3. Excel in Preferred Subjects**
- Biology, Chemistry, Physics are preferred; the best of these gets x1.2 weighting.
- Aim for at least Level 5 in at least two of these subjects.
**4. Prepare for the Interview**
- Interview is required; demonstrate genuine interest in nursing and patient care.
- Be ready to discuss current healthcare issues and your motivation.
**5. Strengthen Your English**
- English Level 4 is typical for median admits; higher is better.
- Practice communication skills for the interview.
**6. Excel in Mathematics**
- Median Maths grade is 5; aim for 5 or above.
- M1/M2 can be counted as an elective if needed.
**7. Use Applied Learning as a Bonus**
- 'Attained with Distinction I/II' in ApL courses can be an extra elective.
- This can add bonus points to your score.
**8. Research the Programme Thoroughly**
- Visit the programme website (http://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk) and CUHK admissions page.
- Understand the curriculum and clinical placement opportunities.
**9. Apply Early and Check Deadlines**
- JUPAS application deadlines are strict; submit before the cut-off.
- Ensure all required documents are ready for interview selection.

curriculum.title: 課程概覽
content: 香港中文大學護理學課程（那打素護理學院）提供全面的五年制課程，融合生物及行為科學、健康促進、護理研究及資訊科技。
主要學習範疇：
- 生物科學（解剖學、生理學、藥理學）
- 行為科學（心理學、社會學）
- 健康促進及維護
- 護理研究及實證實踐
- 在香港主要醫院進行臨床實習
課程強調全人教育，培養學生應對快速變化的醫療環境。
學生透過先進模擬實驗室及跨專科臨床實習獲得實踐經驗。
畢業生可向香港護士管理局申請註冊。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 根據 2023/24 年畢業生調查，超過 90% 的 CUHK 護理畢業生在公立醫院或私營醫療機構任職。
畢業生從事多個專科，包括：
- 內外科護理
- 兒科
- 婦產科
- 深切治療
- 社區健康
- 精神健康
課程的卓越聲譽確保畢業生就業率高，不少畢業生晉升至醫療領導崗位。
就業支援包括臨床實習協調及專業發展工作坊。

campus.title: 校園生活及設施
content: 香港中文大學主校園位於沙田，環境優美，提供超過 9,000 個宿位。
學生可體驗獨特的書院制度，享受緊密的社群及課外活動機會。
那打素護理學院配備現代化模擬實驗室及臨床技能培訓中心。
CUHK 護理學於 QS 世界大學學科排名 2025 位列全球第 5、亞洲第 1、香港第 1。
住宿費約每年 HK$17,000，生活費約 HK$45,000。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力及甄選
content: JS4513 競爭激烈，2025 年 Band A 取錄率約 31.0%。
Band A 申請／取錄比例：約 3.2
入學分數（最佳五科）甚高：中位數 28.6，下四分位數 28.3，上四分位數 33.5。
甄選基於學業成績（DSE 成績）及面試表現。
優先科目（生物、化學、物理）獲額外加權（物理 x1.2）。
申請人應爭取中文至少 5*、數學至少 5 級以具競爭力。

alumni.title: 著名校友及學院卓越成就
content: CUHK 那打素護理學院培育眾多醫療領袖，惟事實包中未列出特定校友姓名。
學院卓越成就：
- 學院於 QS 世界大學學科排名持續位列全球頂尖（全球第 5、亞洲第 1、香港第 1）。
- 配備先進模擬實驗室及香港主要醫院臨床實習機會。
- 畢業生就業率高，並符合香港護士管理局註冊資格。
課程與業界緊密聯繫，確保畢業生充分準備就業。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為本地 JUPAS 學生提供多項入學獎學金，基於學業成績頒發。
獎學金可涵蓋優秀學生的學費及生活費。
設有資助計劃，包括「專上學生資助計劃」（TSFS）及「免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLSPS）。
詳情請瀏覽：https://admission.cuhk.edu.hk/fees-financing-your-studies/
本地學生每年學費為 HK$47,000（2026-2027 年度）。

tips.title: Ace Sir 護理學入學策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 目標分數：爭取中位數 28.6（最佳五科）**
- 中位數 28.6、下四分位數 28.3，各科需有優異成績。
- 中文 5*、英文 4、數學 5，加上兩科選修達 5 級或以上。
- 物理科加權 x1.2，高分可提升總分。
**2. 優先選擇 Band A**
- Band A 取錄率約 31%，Band B-E 無取錄。
- 將 JS4513 置於 Band A 首位以最大化機會。
**3. 在優先科目中表現出色**
- 生物、化學、物理為優先科目，最佳一科獲 x1.2 加權。
- 至少兩科達第 5 級或以上。
**4. 準備面試**
- 面試為必須，展現對護理及病人護理的真正興趣。
- 準備討論當前醫療議題及個人動機。
**5. 加強英文能力**
- 中位數取錄者英文 4 級，更高更佳。
- 練習面試溝通技巧。
**6. 數學成績要突出**
- 中位數數學 5 級，目標 5 級或以上。
- M1/M2 可作選修科計算。
**7. 善用應用學習課程**
- 「達標並表現優異 I/II」可作額外選修科。
- 有助增加總分。
**8. 深入了解課程**
- 瀏覽課程網站（http://www.nur.cuhk.edu.hk）及 CUHK 入學頁面。
- 了解課程內容及臨床實習機會。
**9. 提早申請並留意截止日期**
- JUPAS 申請截止日期嚴格，務必在限期前提交。
- 確保所有文件齊全，以便面試甄選。
